sections.text: Protection

Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction

This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on 
yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

For use with three winding power transformers. the parts 
required for the third winding in addition to the differential relay by 
ancillary (yD203) it has three CT the necessary rectifier and tripping contactor

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmad Galal, tested by eng. Mohamed 
Rabee, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Gaber 
Farahat WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Safety and healthy 
 equipment must be used (safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc).

The transformer must be 
 was isolated.

Make sure CT secondary 
 circuits are shorted.

Ensure all CT path 
 elements are secure after any test disturbance.

sections.text:
Tools and 
Equipment

items: ISA test set type ART/3 or Omicron.
Voltmeter, Ammeter, test plug, and test leads.

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Relays preparation
Review the manual and drawings

Prepare the previous or commissioning 
results of the relay testing
Check the wires of the relay by hand

Check the AC source is available to 
the tester

Check the existence of the DC sources 
in panels

Disconnect the trip leads of the 
relay and connect one of them to the timer of the tester
Check all the leads used in tests

sections.text: Test steps

Connect the voltage leads of a tester 
unit to the relay points according to the drawings and scheme
The 1st at 22 kv
Make dridge in terminal B50-x1 (37-38)a

Inject voltage to each couple of points (21-24) in terminal (B50-x1) till the 
red flag of the device displays in PH (R)a
Record the results pick up value at 0.7 v

Decrease the voltage until the relay is reset and measure the voltage at reset 
0.65 v
Record the results reset value at 0.65 v

Inject voltage to each couple of points (22-24) in terminal (B540-x1) till the 
red flag of the device displays. In PH (S)
Record the results pick up value at 0.7 v

Decrease the voltage until the relay is reset and measure the voltage at reset 
0.65 v
Record the results reset value at 0.65 v

Inject voltage to each couple of points (23-24) in terminal (B50-x1) till the 
red flag of the device displays. In PH (T)
Record the results pick up value at 0.7 v

Decrease the voltage until the relay is reset and measure the voltage at reset 
0.65 v
Record the results reset value at 0.65 v
Switch off secondary injection test set
The 2nd at 6.3 KV

Inject voltage to each couple of points (27-30) in terminal (B50-x1) till the 
red flag of the device displays. In PH (R)
Record the results pick up value at 0.5 v

Decrease the voltage until the relay is reset and measure the voltage at reset 
0.41 v
Record the results reset value at 0.41 v

Inspect voltage to each couple of points (28-30) in terminal (B50-x1) till the 
red flag of the device displays. In PH (S)
Record the results pick up value at 0.5 V

Decrease the voltage until the relay is reset and measure the voltage at reset 
0.41 V
Record the results reset value at 0.41 V

Inject voltage to each couple of points (29-30) in terminal (B50-x1) till the 
red flag of the device displays. In PH (T)
Record the results pick up value at 0.5 v

Decrease the voltage until the relay is reset and measure the voltage at reset 
0.41 V
Record the results reset value at 0.41 V
Switch off secondary injection test set
Return the relay to the panel
Return all connections to the normal position as before the test
Close the work permit
